title: The scale went up… so I must have gained fat, right? 👀
hook: The scale went up… so I must have gained fat, right? 👀
caption:
The scale went up… so I must have gained fat, right? 👀

Not necessarily.

Your body weight naturally fluctuates from day to day because of things like water retention, food volume, sodium, carbohydrates, training and your menstrual cycle.

That’s why I’m learning not to put too much meaning into ONE weigh-in. This is something I’ve only recently come to terms with.

Instead, I will be looking at my weekly average and the bigger picture — strength, measurements, how I feel, how my clothes fit and how consistently I’m showing up.

title: 16kg down by enjoying the journey.
hook: 16kg down by enjoying the journey.
caption:
16kg down by enjoying the journey.

2 years ago, after my photoshoot, I had a completely different goal.

I wanted work on my weaknesses and the 2 things I’ve always struggle with…

Increasing my strength and building size. 

So that’s exactly what I did.

I spent just under a year in a building phase, pushing my training, eating more and getting stronger.

Eventually, I got to 90kg (the heaviest I’d ever been).

Now, I did however gain more body fat than I’d have liked.

But it was part of the process at the time.
